blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `startAuthMfa` method. This belongs to the Auth Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).
This method starts multi-factor authentication (MFA) setup for an auth identity using the requested provider.

```ts
const mfaSetup = await authModuleService.startAuthMfa({
  auth_identity_id: "authusr_123",
  provider: "totp",
  label: "My App",
  issuer: "MyCompany"
})
```
